book.title: LOMA MeLoma ꞌidi leta Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Mabwaiyada ꞌilobwainegita ma ꞌada toloinao taheꞌasisiyanedi, weyahina ꞌidi paihowaina Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaediya. Ma ꞌeguma ꞌidi paihowaina geya Yehoba ꞌoinega, geya sawasawahidi sihetoloina ꞌoida.
Eeta ꞌeguma taiya toloinaedi ꞌisinalidiya beno Yehoba ꞌina paihowa ꞌisinaliya, eeta ꞌabwa maisa galana ꞌiloba Yehoba ꞌoinega.

Ta toloinaedi ꞌidi paihowa geya ꞌabehega tobwebweꞌadi siꞌehematautedi, ma topui hesiyage siꞌehematautedi ꞌidi puiyao weyahidi. Ta ꞌeguma geya nuwami toloinaedi wamatautedi, mumugami hedeyage sidumwalu, eema ꞌane siꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegomi.

Weyahina taudi Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao ma ꞌane siꞌabihetegomi. Ma ꞌeguma mumugami galana, nata waꞌateyoho, weyahina taudi toloinao ꞌabwa siloinegomi. Weyahina Yehoba loina ꞌiꞌebwaediya ma topui siloinaedi.
Eeta ꞌilobwaineya ma toloinao taheꞌasisiyanedi, tabu ta loina taloba, beno ꞌeguma mumuga bwebweꞌana nuwanuwada.
Sawasawahina wete ꞌida takesi taꞌebwaedi, weyahina taudi Yehoba ꞌihesinuwediya ta ꞌina paihowa sipaipaihowa.
Coinega takesi ꞌadi tuta ꞌewa ꞌoina maꞌida tagwala tatakesi, ma weteyage toloinao ma babada taheꞌasisiyanedi ma weyahidi tayaliyaya.

Cami buki wahemaisa hegumwalidi, eema ꞌane buki ꞌaigeda tuwa weyahina wanuwanuwatuhu beno helau, tauna geya sawasawahida tahemaisa hegumwali, weyahina ꞌeguma ꞌiyadao tahelauwedi beno loina mabwaiyadi tapaihowediya,
loinaedi ꞌane gide sigwaeya, sahena logwali, sahena loheꞌamasa, sahena yagaha, sahena matalolo, eema tupwadi wete. Ma loinaedi ꞌadi bwagila, bewa gide ꞌigwaeya,
Ceguma loina bewa ꞌupaihowa, ꞌana gwae gide beno Mosese ꞌina loinao mabwaiyadi ꞌupaipaihowadi, weyahina ꞌeguma taiya ꞌatena helau ꞌimiyamiya, nata geya sowana ꞌiyanao ꞌidi miya ꞌiꞌabihegala.

Ee ꞌoinega bewa tutaina sawasawahina tuwa ꞌeguma gide wapaihowa ꞌesa, weyahina ꞌida tuta ꞌiꞌiunamo ma ꞌigumwala. Yesu boꞌi wahemiseya, ee ꞌoinega sahena waꞌenoꞌeno ma hesi waꞌoꞌoyatola, weyahina ꞌida tuta ꞌiꞌiunamo ma ꞌada Toꞌabiheteina ꞌilatuma.
Ta moisa tuwa ꞌiꞌiunamo gona ꞌiꞌadale, eema ꞌane nihuwana ꞌana paihowa taꞌebesine, ma taꞌatububugita sabwelo ꞌana paihowa weyahina.
Coinega taꞌita yahigita ma sahena weꞌaha waiwaina tanumanuma ma taheyauyaule, sahena wete talologwali, ma sahena wete taheꞌahwa panapanawa, nuwana taheꞌupwa besobeso.
Sahena baleꞌu mumugana weyahina tanuwanuwatuhu, ma hesiyage ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso mumuganega tatauya.
